title: ID0389646-DC/Si-D/SG [MP / R4 170001683] XF4 unable to connect to mobile
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
XF4 unable to connect to mobile
Root cause: Dual Mobile in XF4 router setting
Solution: use SSH/command line to set Wi-Fi as WAN3
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: No
Warranty Valid: Valid till Jan 2025

additional_info.subject: Sicharge D 170001683: XF4 unable to connect to mobile
additional_info.body:
Dear Helpdesk,
Product: Sicharge D
Serial number: 170001683
Country: Singapore
We are trying to commission the charger using 2 SIM cards by the mobile provider Starhub
XF3: insert SIM card on default Siemens APN works perfectly fine, charger is connected to SCB
XF4: after updating the WAN setting, the charger remains disconnected even when we had
Ensure APN name is correct (shwap)
Enabled force LTE
Scanned for operators and ensure auto connection to operator
Swap the sim card with another provider Singtel  (still disconnected)
Check that the sim card is activated
XF4 still remain disconnected via Mobile.
Please kindly help.
With best regards,
Edna Seah
Siemens Pte Ltd
RC-SG SI E
60 MacPherson Road
348615 Singapore, Singapore
Mobile: +65 9816 9400
mailto:edna.seah@siemens.com
www.twitter.com/siemens
www.siemens.com

additional_info.subject: Observation from reetesh
additional_info.body:
Charger is on very old FW v2.5.9.4, as RC to bring the charger to 4.0.11 via USB update and we can configure the XF4 via SSH
Router 2 XF4 has dual Mobile WAN, set WAN3 as Wi-Fi via command line
